title: Simultaneous whole-tower pullback comparison datum
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$. For noetherian finite-dimensional schemes $T$ with $\ell$ invertible, use the coefficient comparison data of [def-fd-coefficient-comparison-datum]. A simultaneous pullback comparison datum consists of one such coefficient datum for every $T$, an integral whole-diagram realization system of [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization] satisfying its composition, unit, scalar and associator normalizations for every inclusion of finite coefficient fields, and the following data for every scheme isomorphism $h:U\simeq T$. It supplies a finite pullback comparison datum of [def-fd-finite-pullback-comparison-datum] for every finite coefficient field, and a natural isomorphism on the common-stage pair categories. The framework stage family has the actual rational pullbacks and scalar comparisons of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and descends to its actual common-stage pullback. The target stage family is the actual PBC pullback family of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. The two composite coefficient/pullback stage-system morphisms are connected by a compatible transformation whose finite components are the specified finite rational comparison; this is exactly the mixed scalar square. At each literal pair the common-stage natural isomorphism is the finite-stage inclusion of that rational component. This definition asserts no existence and leaves identity/composition compatibility of the inter-system scheme comparison to the owning existence theorem.
